Diagram maintenance

These four conceptual maps connect the reading path, its developmental aim, and selected core views, with complete Chinese counterparts:

  • Steal Fire, Then Become Fire (formation-path) places ongoing human–model practice at the center of trajectories, reflection, personal philosophy and models, and environments and works. The developmental aim gives the whole a direction; new experience returns through the relationships. It condenses the five-part argument without reproducing the article directory.

  • Join in stealing fire, and use it to cultivate yourself (borrowed-fire) develops the stealing-fire essay's practical argument under a chosen developmental purpose. It separates accumulated works from demonstrated changes in the person's capacities, including reliably supported capacities. The person participates in the collective work rather than appearing only as a recipient of its results; the diagram does not require each participant to reproduce industrial model production.

  • How people and models inquire together (encounter) connects YY-05, YY-10, and YY-11: records, candidate models, an adopted view, generated work, and returning evidence within human–model activity. YY-09 supplies its event-based vocabulary.

  • From understanding the world to realizing a practice (layers) develops YY-09: physical grounding, computational abstraction, and the relations among ontology, epistemology, value, methods, and practice.

For the two detailed maps, the candidate JSON files own the authored labels, relationships, guided views, and explanatory cards. HTML is the standalone interactive viewer. SVG is the viewer's native static export of the graph and legend; the HTML cards and guided views remain available in the viewer.

Regeneration

The two responsive concept maps use reading-maps.json for their bilingual concepts, relationship labels, and accessible descriptions. Run python3 skills/yinyang/scripts/render-reading-maps.py from the collection. The renderer owns two explicit SVG compositions, with separate desktop and mobile geometry. It generates self-contained HTML and full SVG diagrams. It uses the Site's existing color and system-font vocabulary without external dependencies. Nodes and directed connections carry the meaning; there are no article lists, disclosure cards, cross-diagram links, or standalone-view buttons inside them. The complete graph remains visible without JavaScript. The Site adapts frame height and theme only. Inspect label readability, node and edge relationships, and both viewport compositions. The philosophy directory retains four compact review links after its five chapter entries; it embeds no diagram.

The two detailed viewers use Archify 3.1.0. From the Yinyang references directory, set ARCHIFY_CLI to the installed bin/archify.mjs and choose a temporary CHECK_DIR for the run:

node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/encounter.candidate.json diagrams/encounter.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/encounter" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/layers.candidate.json diagrams/layers.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/layers" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/encounter.zh-CN.candidate.json diagrams/encounter.zh-CN.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/encounter-zh" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/layers.zh-CN.candidate.json diagrams/layers.zh-CN.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/layers-zh" --json

Regenerate only changed candidates or artifacts requiring repair. After successful finalization, use Export → SVG · Auto (or 导出 → SVG · 自动) for the matching static export. Headless browser controls preserve desktop focus. Retain the semantic translation overrides when updating the tool: they describe questions and modeled relationships rather than software services.

Check meaningful labels, directions, and readability against the owning text. Native delivery and browser receipts are execution evidence and contain local paths; keep them with that execution rather than distributing a second hash registry. A future checkout can run its own checks on its actual artifacts.

Trace motion follows authored arrows. It illustrates local relationships, not a mandatory sequence, causal strength, or measured rate of development. Both maps leave activity outside their selected questions unrepresented.

Retain third-party notices with viewers and exports; the original claims keep their own license.
